narrative.overview: Hindsight is a flight recorder for AI agents, and the studio dresses the part: a warm, analog instrument panel for reading a run's black box and branching a new one. The canvas is printout-tape cream, the structural voice is a monospaced instrument readout, and a single burnt-ember accent behaves like the one warning lamp on a console: rare, unambiguous, reserved for failure and the fork that answers it. Depth is mostly flat — hairline borders and tonal steps — with shadows and glows appearing only as a response to state.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream canvas, never cool gray or pure white.
One ember accent, spent almost entirely on failure and fork.
Monospace as instrumentation — labels, data, and structure, not costume.
Flat by default; depth is a response to state.
Geometry carries meaning (circle = reasoning, square = side-effect).

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Ember is the console's warning light. Spend it on failure and on the fork that fixes it, plus the wordmark and focus. If ember is decorating a healthy screen, remove it.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries warmth. Never introduce cool gray, blue-black, or a pure-white page background.

rules.name: The Instrument Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for data, labels, measurement, and code — never as a decorative techy costume on prose.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Acted Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow or halo is a claim that something changed.

rules.name: The Error-Tab Exception
rules.body: A 3px ember border-left marks error surfaces — the one place a thick colored edge is allowed. New callouts use a full 1px border.

dos: Do keep the canvas cream (#F6F2EA) and every neutral warm.
Do reserve ember for failure, the fork, focus, and the wordmark.
Do monospace data, labels, ids, and code; set prose in Inter.
Do stay flat at rest and let shadows/halos signal state changes only.
Do encode meaning in geometry where you can (circle vs. square step dots).
Do cap prose measure near 76ch and keep the smallest readable text ≥12px / AA contrast.
donts: Don't introduce cool gray, blue-black, or a pure-white page background.
Don't put a second ember call-to-action on a screen, or ember-decorate a healthy state.
Don't use monospace as a decorative technical costume on prose.
Don't add a thick colored border-left anywhere except the established error surfaces.
Don't add resting shadows to cards or introduce a second chromatic accent beyond ember + success green.
